en.headline: Transport chief says 16,000 have applied for taxi and ride-hailing exam
en.dek: Mable Chan expects the first batch of ride-hailing platform licences to be announced from late November to early December, while noting the government will scrutinise bus fare applications.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that more than 16,000 people had applied for the combined written test for taxi and ride-hailing vehicle permits since it opened in August.

The figure exceeds the 10,000 ride-hailing vehicle permits the government plans to issue in the first phase. Chan said if applications for the permits outstrip the quota, the authorities would consider giving higher chances to those who passed the exam early and to owners who have held private cars for a certain period, such as one year.

Platform applications for ride-hailing licences close at the end of this month. Chan said she would wait to see the results and hoped capable large-scale operators would apply. The first batch of approved platforms is expected to be announced from the end of November to early December.

Separately, four franchised bus operators have applied for fare increases ranging from 8.1 per cent to 17.7 per cent. Chan said oil price fluctuations posed operational challenges, but the government would look beyond short-term pressure to longer-term factors when considering the applications. She added that the government would encourage bus companies to expand non-fare revenue such as advertising and convenience stores at interchanges.

zh.headline: 運輸局局長指的士及網約車綜合筆試已有 1.6 萬人報考
zh.dek: 陳美寶表示，網約車平台牌照首批結果料於 11 月底至 12 月初公布，並會審慎考慮巴士加價申請。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六表示，自 8 月開放報名以來，已有逾 1.6 萬人報考的士及網約車綜合筆試。
數字超出政府計劃首階段發出的 1 萬個網約車牌照。陳美寶指，若申請牌照人數超出配額，初步計劃提高某些類別人士的中籤機會，例如較早報考並取得資格的車主，以及擁有私家車一段時間（例如一年）的申請者。
網約車平台牌照申請將於本月底截止。陳美寶表示對結果拭目以待，期望吸引有實力的大型平台申請。首批獲批平台預計於 11 月底至 12 月初公布。
另外，四間專營巴士公司申請加價，幅度由 8.1% 至 17.7%。陳美寶指油價波動對營運構成挑戰，但政府除審視短期壓力外，亦會考慮長遠及宏觀因素。她又表示會推動巴士公司拓展非票務收入，例如車身廣告及在轉乘站增設便利店。
